K1.text: Sessions are watermark-revocable (tokenVersion/isActive checked per request), refresh tokens are single-use DB rows in an HttpOnly cookie with replay revoking all sessions (SEC-02 fixed), and family/admin invite, verify and reset tokens are stored hashed (SEC-03 fixed) and spent by POST.

K2.text: Admin login requires TOTP (single-use step, constant-time compare, secret sealed at rest, SEC-14 fixed), roles are default-deny in authenticateAdmin (SEC-05 fixed), moderators need a TOTP step-up (SEC-11 fixed), and /admin/* additionally needs a Cloudflare Access JWT.

K3.text: Swept the Fastify route registrations (incl. new checkin and billing modules): every route has authenticate/authenticateAdmin/modAuth except the intentionally public /health, /auth signup/login/refresh/verify/password, /admin/auth/login, /feedback/public-idea, invitation preview/decline and the signature-checked /billing/webhook; no 'use server' (API only).

K4.text: By-id services resolve membership from the row's circle and answer 404 identical to missing for not-yours (SEC-12 fixed, source-guard test), assignees are validated (SEC-13 fixed); re-confirmed by the fix commits and guard tests, not a fresh line-by-line read of every service.

K5.text: Limits live in Postgres (SEC-06 fixed) with per-account lockout, but the unauthenticated token reads GET /invitations/:token/preview and POST /invitations/:token/decline still carry no config.rateLimit.

K6.text: Family and admin invite links are hashed at rest with 14-day expiry, revocable (renew/revoke), and served with no-store/no-referrer/noindex plus URL masking in logs and 404s (SEC-03, SEC-04 fixed).

K7.text: The API sets CSP frame-ancestors none, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, nosniff, HSTS and CORP on every response (SEC-07 fixed); both SPAs and the marketing site ship header config in vercel.json.

K8.text: JWT_SECRET, ANALYTICS_PEPPER and TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY require 32+ chars and reject repo placeholders unless NODE_ENV=test (SEC-01 fixed), APP_BASE_URL/TERMS_VERSION fail closed (SEC-16), the CF Access gate is closed when unset, nothing secret is tracked (only .env.example), and no VITE_ secrets exist.

K9.text: The Stripe webhook now exists: raw body kept in its own plugin scope and verified with stripe.webhooks.constructEvent (signature plus the default 300s timestamp tolerance), and every event re-reads the subscription from Stripe so replays and failed events converge idempotently without an event table.

K10.text: Request-log serializer and 404 handler mask invite tokens (SEC-04 fixed), buildApp refuses to boot in production without an email transport (SEC-09 fixed) and the log-only sender is unreachable there.

K11.text: The zod schema now covers PORT, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, DOCUMENT_STORE, allowance, Stripe, Resend and TRUST_PROXY, but .env.example still omits CHECKIN_CONSENT_HMAC_KEY and CHECKIN_TRANSCRIPT_KEY (both read via env), and RENDER_GIT_COMMIT/FEATURE_* are read raw outside the schema (flags by design).

K12.text: Unit tests use in-process in-memory PGlite and the race tests a CI-service local Postgres (no cloud URL reachable, though no explicit cloud-URL guard); no e2e suite exists so the production-build rule does not yet apply.

K13.text: DB triggers make AdminActionLog, ModerationAction, VaultAccessLog (and later ProfileResolutionLog) append-only, refusing DELETE/TRUNCATE except the erasure path (SEC-08 fixed); a table-owning role could still drop them (production REVOKE is an OPS item).

K14.text: PORT now defaults to 4301 in config (alongside is the handhold row 4300-4302 in the port table), handhold-site, frontend and admin-frontend vercel.json all carry the ignoreCommand, and the cron is a Render CLI job rather than a route (HEAD 37dffdb, 2026-11-10).
